description: Look up one Dutch regulation by its BWB id (e.g. "BWBR0005537") as it stood on "as_of" (default today): citeertitel, authority, legal domain(s), the toestand's own validity period (separate from publication/in-force dates), its chapter structure, and a paged list of article numbers (offset/limit, has_more/next_offset — never truncated silently). Pass an article number to nl_wetten_get_article to read its text.

as_of.description: Resolve to the version valid on this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.
